title: Chapter 47: Huge Gap In Military Strength
content:
Chapter 47: Huge Gap In Military Strength

In the military camp of the Tiger Leader, Wu Qing confirmed the information about the bugbear clan's expedition, and said to Meng beside him: "The situation is clear. We are going to have a big battle with the bugbear clan in the wild today!"

He had no intention of hiding the secret of the rapid transmission of Zerg information from Meng.

"You already know the intelligence on the front line? The Zerg are really a mysterious race!"

"How many troops are there in the enemy? Where is the target?"

Meng was surprised, but he didn't ask about the secrets of the Zerg, he just asked about the enemy's intelligence.

He is very aware of the importance of intelligence transmission in a war. With such an efficient means of information transmission, the Zerg will have an absolute intelligence advantage on the battlefield.

Intelligence is one of the key factors that affects the outcome of a war.

"There are lizardmen, bugbears, 2,000 long-armed ogres, and 2,000 bugbear cavalry. The total strength is about 100,000 people."

"Their goal is to sweep away the territory in this area, but I guess that with their lineup, they want to have a big battle with us."

Wu Qing answered truthfully.

"This configuration of troops and types of troops is indeed meant to target the Zerg."

"Are you sure?"

Meng learned about the two main combat arms of the Zerg from Wu Qing's mouth, and had a certain understanding of the combat methods of the Puppies and Hydralisks.

He was still a little worried about the insufficient strength of the Zerg. He brought Wu Qing to the military camp to tell Wu Qing that the elite troops here could go to the battlefield at any time when needed.

He felt that the Zerg and the elite troops of the Tiger Leader had a good chance of victory in a battle with the Bugbear Clan.

"Don't worry, you can watch the Zerg fight with them first. I won't be polite when I need you to play."

Wu Qing replied with a smile.

"Okay! Have you figured out where to block the attack? We can set off!"

Without being pretentious, he nodded his tiger head and urged Wu Qing to send troops as soon as possible.

"They have so many troops, so we will find a more complex terrain to use as the battlefield."

"Let's go now!"

Wu Qing has already selected the battlefield terrain. As long as the bugbear army continues to march, it will always encounter complex terrain. The Zerg with intelligence superiority can stop it.

This is the information advantage brought by intelligence acquisition and transmission, and favorable battlefield positions can be prioritized.

"Warriors of the Tiger Clan! Follow me on the expedition!"

"Other warriors, please stay in the military camp! The Tiger Territory needs your protection!"

He suddenly rode on an extraordinarily huge colorful tiger and loudly ordered to the entire army.

His voice was loud and deafening.

"Go to war!"

The tiger cavalry shouted in unison and set out to fight with a terrifying momentum!

Meng and Wu Qing took the lead to rush out of the military camp, followed closely by the Tiger Cavalry, the Insect Man and the Hydralisk, and finally the puppy.

This combined army from the two territories went straight out of the city and, led by a few puppies, rushed towards the target area.

On the way, the Zerg army came from the Zerg territory to join forces, bringing the total number of Zerg troops to a small dog and 1,000 Hydralisks.

"Is this all the Zerg troops participating in the war?"

Looking at the Zerg army that came to join together, he was a little disappointed with the number.

The total strength of the entire army was slightly different from that of the bugbears.

"Even if the bugbears have a lot of lizardmen who can make up the numbers, it's still a little difficult to win this battle!"

Meng said bluntly to Wu Qing.

"Don't worry! The Zerg fighting style is different, our reinforcements will come!"

"We can just watch the Zerg show!"

Wu Qing smiled at Meng and didn't explain much.

"Haha, now that you say that, I feel relieved!"

"Then I'll wait and see!"

Meng had great trust in Wu Qing and the Zerg. With Wu Qing's guarantee, he felt relieved.

Around the combined army, there were many scouts sent from the surrounding territories, and Wu Qing asked them to follow them.

The scouts of the bugbear clan had long been eliminated by the puppies.

After marching for about an hour, the combined army arrived at an area with rugged rocks, thorns, and trees. There were also huge boulders and small mountains crisscrossing the area. The terrain and environment here were extremely complex.

This kind of landform, like a belt, spreads for a long distance, blocking the only way forward for the Bugbear family's army.

According to common sense, such a place is very unsuitable for a large army to fight. Seeing such terrain, I frowned.

"In a place like this? How can we fight?"

Meng asked in confusion.

"For ordinary people, such a place is not suitable for fighting, but the Zerg never chooses a place to fight!"

“It’s great here!”

The Zerg are an interstellar race. They can survive in all kinds of harsh environments in the universe. The terrain here is very friendly to them.

Wu Qing began to command the Zerg to occupy a favorable position and prepare to welcome the enemy's arrival.

He rode to a hill with a relatively flat top, and wanted to mobilize the tiger cavalry to guard them with the insect men.

"The Tiger Cavalry will stay here and watch the Zerg fight first. If necessary, we will take the field."

At this time, the army of bugbears is not far away from here. Their target is the Zerg. Even if they change their route midway and send puppies to lure them, they can still be lured over.

The waiting time seemed particularly long, but fortunately Meng and his Tiger Cavalry were all real professional soldiers, and they did not show any impatience.

The forward scouts of the bear goblin army have already explored, and the Zerg did not attack these scouts, so these scouts had a clear view of the Zerg's troop deployment.

The Zerg is now showing its strength, and it depends on whether you dare to come.

If you dare to come, then fight! If you don't dare to come, then chase! It's that simple!

The army of the bear goblin tribe has entered the area with complex terrain, and Wu Qing's goal has been achieved.

The bear goblin scout immediately sent the intelligence back to the headquarters army, and the bear goblin army, which received the news, slowed down its march.

A long dragon-like marching formation slowly unfolded and turned into a combat formation.

From the various skilled changes in the army of the bear goblin tribe, it can be seen that these evil god believers are well-trained.

After the change of formation, the army was marching slowly and moving forward continuously.

This shows that this army is determined to defeat the Zerg, ignoring the influence of unfavorable terrain.

"It seems that the Bugbears are full of confidence this time!"

Looking at the Bugbears army in the distance, his expression was a little solemn.

On the surface, the Zerg army is at an absolute disadvantage. When this battle starts, everyone except Wu Qing will be a little worried about the outcome.

After the Bugbears army deployed its troops, the long-armed ogres came to the front, and the Bugbear cavalry was divided into two teams, wandering on both sides of the army.

When the Bugbears army approached some of the Zerg's front-line puppies, the long-armed ogres suddenly roared in unison, all of them rushed forward to help, and threw a heavy javelin far away in the direction of the puppies.

Nearly 2,000 javelin flew high, drew a long arc, and shot into the puppies at high speed.
